command:
set -eu
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsadmin; fi
tmp_allow=$(mktemp /etc/cron.allow.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp_allow"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' root opsadmin > "$tmp_allow"
chown root:root "$tmp_allow"
chmod 0600 "$tmp_allow"
mv -f "$tmp_allow" /etc/cron.allow
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' 'configured cron allow-list and opsadmin account'
